title: Broncos lose All-Pro CB Patrick Surtain II to non-contact ankle injury in loss to 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos lose All-Pro CB Patrick Surtain II to non-contact ankle injury in loss to 49ers
sources.description: Surtain received treatment on the field after the play and needed the help of two medical trainers to limp off the field to the locker room.
